sections.title: THE CLUB
sections.body: Castmog Ladies Football Academy is dedicated to developing female footballers through quality coaching, competitive football, mentorship, discipline and holistic player development.

sections.title: CLUB HISTORY
sections.body: Castmog Football Academy was founded on 12 September 2009 (a club website states it was set up in Osun State, Nigeria), while other sources place the academy in Abeokuta, Ogun State. The academy develops and discovers promising talents across Nigeria.

sections.title: LEAGUE FOOTBALL
sections.body: Castmog Ladies' official X account states the club was promoted to the NWFL Premier League. In November 2025 the Nigeria Women Football League (NWFL) confirmed the relegation of Castmog Ladies from the 2025/2026 NWFL Premier League over registration and licensing non-compliance.

sections.title: PARTNERSHIPS
sections.body: We collaborate with sponsors, organisations and stakeholders who share our vision of developing women’s football and creating greater opportunities for female players.

sections.title: HOME GROUND
sections.body: The academy's Instagram profile references Asero Stadium, Ogun State, Nigeria.

sections.title: MISSION & VISION
sections.body: To develop talented, disciplined and intelligent female footballers while building a sustainable and respected institution in Nigerian women’s football.

sections.title: CLUB PHILOSOPHY
sections.body: We promote intelligent, disciplined and proactive football, developing players who are technically skilled, tactically aware, mentally strong and committed to teamwork

sections.title: CLUB TIMELINE
sections.body: Castmog Ladies Football Academy has grown from a grassroots initiative into a competitive women’s football club, with promotion to the NWFL Premier League marking a major milestone in its journey
